title: Vue components
description: For a Vue 3 interface: typed props and emits, composables, one-way data flow, list keys, v-html and type checking of single-file components.

sources.title: Vue.js guide, using Vue with TypeScript

rules.instruction: Declare the props and emitted events of each changed component with `defineProps` and `defineEmits`, with a type or a runtime definition for each.
rules.verification: Search the changed components for array-only prop declarations and undeclared `emit` calls, and run the project's type check.

rules.instruction: Do not mutate props in a child component. Copy them into local state or a computed value, or emit an event the parent handles.
rules.verification: Run the component tests with Vue warnings treated as failures, and review the change for assignments to props or their nested fields.

rules.instruction: Move stateful logic shared by components into a composable named `useX`, and remove its listeners and timers in `onUnmounted`.
rules.verification: Test the composable in a mounted host component and check that unmounting removes its listeners.

rules.instruction: Give each `v-for` a stable `:key`, and filter lists in a computed value rather than combining `v-if` with `v-for` on one element.
rules.verification: Run the project's Vue lint rules on the changed templates.

rules.instruction: Do not pass user-provided content to `v-html` or use it as a component template. Render it as text or sanitize it with the approved library.
rules.verification: Search the change for `v-html` and dynamic templates, and test the component with content containing a script element.

rules.instruction: Type-check `.vue` files with `vue-tsc` in the build or CI step, since the development server does not type-check.
rules.verification: Run the project's `vue-tsc` command on the branch and confirm it reports no error.
